scene: In a quiet lantern-lit textile boutique at blue dusk, seated on a low stool and turning gently toward camera, unfolding an unlettered embroidered cloth over her lap with each hand on a separate edge. Both complete hands visible, copper lanterns and patterned fabric shelves.
outfit: Modern heritage-inspired cinnamon wrap blouse with short flutter sleeves and a secured low square neckline, cream high-waisted flowing midi skirt with a side slit, small crescent hair pin. Bare forearms shoulders and part of one leg; soft woven fabric, no armor.
custom: Same adult woman as approved light reference. Remove bear-ear headband and tail sash; only tiny crescent jewelry. Five fingers per hand, no extra people or armor.
camera: 1024x1536 vertical, eye-level. All essential hand gestures inside the crop.
